metadata.question: Was there a decrease in rainfall in Zimbabwe in February 2024 compared to February 2023?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Was there a decrease in rainfall in Zimbabwe in February 2024 compared to February 2023?" We need to: 1. Use rainfall data - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is appropriate. 2. Define Zimbabwe's geometry. 3. Get rainfall data for February 2024 and February 2023. 4. Compare the two months' rainfall totals or averages. 5. Output evidence and the final answer tag. Considerations: - Data: CHIRPS daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY). - Time periods: February 2024 (2024-02-01 to 2024-02-29) and February 2023 (2023-02-01 to 2023-02-28). - Process: Sum daily precipitation for each month, then calculate mean over Zimbabwe. - Check for data availability (C1) and valid pixels (C2). - Validate results (not None/NaN). - Output concise evidence and final tag. We'll use the following steps: 1. Authenticate and initialize. 2. Get Zimbabwe geometry from FAO GAUL. 3. Define date ranges. 4. For each month: - Filter CHIRPS collection by date. - Check if collection is empty -> try recovery? CHIRPS should have data, but if not, we can try other datasets (e.g., ERA5). However, the question specifies rainfall, so CHIRPS is best. - Sum the daily images to get monthly total. - Compute mean rainfall over Zimbabwe using reduceRegion. - Also compute pixel count to check for valid data. 5. Compare the two means: if 2024 mean < 2023 mean, answer A (Yes), else B (No). 6. Handle edge cases (C1, C2, C3). We must print concise evidence (max 20 lines) and the final tag. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Get Zimbabwe boundary from FAO GAUL const zimbabwe = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Zimbabwe')); // Define date ranges for February 2024 and February 2023 const feb2024Start = '2024-02-01'; const feb2024End = '2024-02-29'; // 2024 is a leap year const feb2023Start = '2023-02-01'; const feb2023End = '2023-02-28'; // Helper function to process a month async function processMonth(startDate, endDate, label) { // Filter CHIRPS daily collection let chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); // Check collection size const size = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Images: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try fallback: ERA5-Land monthly aggregated (if CHIRPS fails) // For rainfall, we can use ERA5-Land's total precipitation // But note: ERA5-Land is reanalysis, not exactly the same. // We'll try to recover with ERA5-Land monthly. console.log(`No CHIRPS data for ${label}, trying ERA5-Land.`); // ERA5-Land monthly: "ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY" // Band: 'total_precipitation_sum' (in meters, convert to mm by *1000) const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('total_precipitation_sum'); const era5Size = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 ${label} Images: ${era5Size}`); if (era5Size === 0) { return { mean: null, count: 0, label: label, error: 'C1' }; } // Sum the monthly images (usually one image per month) const monthlySum = era5.sum().multiply(1000); // Convert m to mm // Rename band for consistency const rainfall = monthlySum.rename('precipitation'); // Compute statistics const stats = rainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 10000, // ERA5-Land resolution is ~11 km maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean = stats.get('precipitation_mean'); const count = stats.get('precipitation_count'); return { mean: mean, count: count, label: label, error: null }; } // Sum daily precipitation to get monthly total const monthlySum = chirps.sum(); // Compute mean rainfall and pixel count over Zimbabwe const stats = monthlySum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 5000, // CHIRPS resolution is ~5.5 km maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean = stats.get('precipitation_mean'); const count = stats.get('precipitation_count'); return { mean: mean, count: count, label: label, error: null }; } // Process both months const month2023 = await processMonth(feb2023Start, feb2023End, 'Feb2023'); const month2024 = await processMonth(feb2024Start, feb2024End, 'Feb2024'); // Check for errors (C1: empty collection) if (month2023.error === 'C1' || month2024.error === 'C1') { console.log('C1: Empty collection for one or both months.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the values const mean2023 = month2023.mean.getInfo(); const count2023 = month2023.count.getInfo(); const mean2024 = month2024.mean.getInfo(); const count2024 = month2024.count.getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels (C2) if (count2023 === 0 || count2024 === 0) { console.log(`Feb2023 valid pixels: ${count2023}, Feb2024 valid pixels: ${count2024}`); console.log('C2: No valid pixels in one or both months.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validate results (C3) if (mean2023 === null || mean2024 === null || isNaN(mean2023) || isNaN(mean2024) || mean2023 < 0 || mean2024 < 0 || // Rainfall shouldn't be negative mean2023 > 10000 || mean2024 > 10000) { // Unrealistically high (in mm) console.log(`Feb2023 mean: ${mean2023}, Feb2024 mean: ${mean2024}`); console.log('C3: Invalid calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Print evidence console.log(`Feb2023 mean rainfall (mm): ${mean2023.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Feb2024 mean rainfall (mm): ${mean2024.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Feb2023 pixel count: ${count2023}`); console.log(`Feb2024 pixel count: ${count2024}`); // Determine answer if (mean2024 < mean2023) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
